distilled_rules: Use staged presentation workflow: planning -> design spec -> 1-2 sample slides -> full build.
Treat DESIGN.md as an AI-facing design contract containing tokens plus rationale; PPT use is an adaptation, not an official universal spec.
HTML can be an alternate rapid-generation/iteration lane, not a replacement for editable PPTX requirements.
Image-slot prompting is useful when placeholders include position, ratio, intended image description and later replacement metadata.
Author-specific quantitative claims, rankings, pricing and universal image-slot ratios are not promoted without primary verification.
